description: HIRA calibration v2 evaluation set. 25 activities: 2 benchmarks (BENCH-1, BENCH-6) and 23 Indian manufacturing activities. For DRAFT activities the per-hazard likelihood/severity are what an uncalibrated LLM (the v1 Copilot) proposed; recommendedControls are the controls it proposed (v1 showed all of them). For STORED activities the rating is the team's own single entry rating. 'expected' is an HSE judgement made before running the engine; 'TODO(HSE lead)' means not yet agreed. Used by scripts/hira_calibration_eval.py.

STD_5X5.note: Standard 5x5, frequency-anchored likelihood, MODERATE tolerable with ALARP.

JSL_QSD24_GT.note: JSL Hisar plant method QSD/24 (GT > 3.33 significant): plant-index likelihood, MODERATE not acceptable.
